input.text:
Rewrite and restructure the live human-submission manuscript's Sections 1 and 2.

Section 1 must preserve and fully develop this reasoning order: formal Clay problem and definitions; a curated history that explains the results the paper later needs and ends with a concrete account of the present frontier; the Gold proof as a concise direct-estimate overview with no artificial Y variable and no reader-losing full derivation; Thomas's Silver contrapositive movement; class membership as Gold and Silver defining the boundary from opposite sides; participation as the physical meaning of remaining in that class; the Euler tangential-slip comparison; singularity and the velocity-acceleration-jerk derivative tower; the deliberately nonexclusive Dead, Jump, and Blown failure lenses plus a short restart intuition; and the one-fluid object, coherent field, and VPI law as the complete physical and mathematical synthesis.

The supplied subjects are reasoning units, not a demand for ten subsections.
They may be joined or split wherever the reader's reasoning benefits.
Restructuring is explicitly approved.

Develop every distinct idea, bridge, qualification, equation, and example required to make the reasoning legible.
Do not flatten or compress the supplied thought into a skeletal outline or a string of labels.
Do not repeat a concept later unless the recurrence performs a new job.

Dead does not mean raw zero velocity, because stagnation points, steady flows, and the zero solution can be smooth.
It means failure of required participation in the shared local pressure-viscosity response law while a surrounding field remains live.
Jump means incompatible limiting values of velocity or a finite derivative across one point, interface, or time.
Blown means unbounded velocity, derivative, pressure response, or finite-depth tower readout; the velocity itself need not be infinite.
The three labels may overlap and are not claimed to be exhaustive.

The Euler board example must be the precise weak tangential-slip-sheet comparison: normal flux and pressure are compatible while tangential velocity jumps.
It illustrates that weak Euler membership does not imply one-field smooth coherence.
It does not show that every nonsmooth state is Euler.
For fixed positive viscosity, the same discontinuous sheet is not a smooth unforced Navier--Stokes state.

Class membership uses set and Boolean logic, not category theory unless a category is actually defined.
Use Member(Q) implies Smooth(Q), equivalently not Smooth(Q) implies Exit(Q), with Exit(Q) defined as not Member(Q).
Do not use the implication itself as a circular definition of membership.

VPI retains its original discipline: viscosity, pressure, incompressibility, transport, and the differentiated tower remain attached throughout the mathematics.
A graph picture may represent local rungs and neighbour relations, but nonlocal pressure must remain a whole-field coupling and the graph must not replace the PDE.

Section 2 must follow the actual historical discovery: begin inside the finite-time singularity and critical-scale pressure already created by Section 1; resume, rather than restart, the velocity-acceleration-jerk tower; expose the independent temporal and spatial directions of the original pressure-complete mixed jet; derive how critical height reveals the spatial Sobolev column; discover the compatible all-orders intersection as an intersection rather than a sum; and then make that insight finite and checkable through compatible rectangles and restriction maps.

Section 2 is reader-facing discovery, not a second formal proof section.
It may state and derive the exact coordinates and identities required to understand the proof.
Section 3 alone owns invocation of the settled datum-generated whole-terminal compatible-rectangle theorem, terminal projective assembly, endpoint trace, pressure-complete endpoint jet, restart/uniqueness bookkeeping, and the conclusion T_* equals infinity.
Do not reopen, demote, audit, replace, or call missing the settled datum-generated compatible-intersection object.

Remove one-history bookkeeping from Sections 1 and 2.
The physical one-fluid object remains essential.
Restart in Section 1 is only the short intuition that a regular time slice can serve as new initial data; identity, compatibility, and uniqueness bookkeeping stay in Section 3.

Preserve Thomas's complete Silver Standard Proof as the primary reasoning and cadence anchor while correcting grammar, typography, and mathematical precision.
Use plain Canadian English, one sentence per source line, and number a displayed equation only when later reasoning actually cites it.

move.development: Give every beat its physical motivation, exact mathematical object, worked implication, boundary case, and outgoing question; keep formal terminal realization in Section 3 and preserve the supplied datum-generated compatible-intersection theorem.
move.expression: Use direct causal prose, concrete examples, and only the equations that pay a reader burden; preserve Thomas's Silver cadence while removing placeholders, arbitrary proxy variables, and process-report language.

candidate_moves.reader_change: The reader moves from knowing the official question to seeing one coherent fluid ontology and then independently feeling why the proof needs the full pressure-complete mixed tower, its Sobolev readouts, and compatible finite intersections.
candidate_moves.next_possibility: Section 3 can begin directly with the established datum-generated whole-terminal producer and pay the formal endpoint closure without reteaching the conceptual route.

sequence.thought: State the exact regularity problem, define smoothness and continuation, and show how the important historical results progressively narrow the public frontier.
sequence.connection: The formal question naturally invites a direct continuation-grade estimate.
sequence.reader_start: reader knows the formal Clay question but not why the proof methods, class boundary, failure pictures, or tower arise
sequence.reader_end: reader knows precisely what can fail and where the classical literature leaves the burden

sequence.thought: Present Gold as the concise direct proof contract, let its missing estimate generate Silver, then express both as the two sides of the same class boundary.
sequence.connection: The contrapositive changes the question from how to control smoothness to what a nonsmooth endpoint would have to stop being.
sequence.reader_start: reader knows precisely what can fail and where the classical literature leaves the burden
sequence.reader_end: reader sees Member and Exit as positive and negative descriptions of one boundary

sequence.thought: Turn membership into participation, use the Euler slip sheet to show what losing viscous participation looks like, then expose the derivative tower and the overlapping Dead, Jump, and Blown failure lenses.
sequence.connection: A finite velocity can conceal a failed derivative or failed neighbour response, so the full coupled tower is the relevant object.
sequence.reader_start: reader sees Member and Exit as positive and negative descriptions of one boundary
sequence.reader_end: reader can picture and test concrete ways a candidate endpoint could stop belonging to the fluid

sequence.thought: Derive the common transported tower law and the exact neighbour-difference law, retaining transport, pressure, viscosity, incompressibility, and nonlinear rung coupling.
sequence.connection: The failure pictures converge on one physical meaning: part of the fluid ceases to respond coherently to the same field.
sequence.reader_start: reader can picture and test concrete ways a candidate endpoint could stop belonging to the fluid
sequence.reader_end: reader has a complete one-fluid VPI ontology

sequence.thought: Begin from a finite critical-height threat and show why finite-time escape forces response through higher temporal and spatial levels.
sequence.connection: Critical scaling identifies the height at which the endpoint threat cannot be dismissed by subcritical energy alone.
sequence.reader_start: reader has a complete one-fluid VPI ontology
sequence.reader_end: reader sees why time response and spatial height must be tracked together

sequence.thought: Derive the pressure-complete mixed jet, the critical-height rows, the all-orders Sobolev intersection, finite adjacent rectangles, and compatibility on overlap.
sequence.connection: Every temporal row opens a spatial column, while Sobolev embedding turns simultaneous control at every finite height into smoothness.
sequence.reader_start: reader sees why time response and spatial height must be tracked together
sequence.reader_end: reader understands why the proof object is a compatible coordinatewise intersection rather than an infinite sum

sequence.thought: Separate strict-subinterval existence from the whole-terminal quantifier and hand the exact latter burden to the already settled producer used in Section 3.
sequence.connection: Compatibility explains the object; the datum-generated uniform terminal bound realizes it.
sequence.reader_start: reader understands why the proof object is a compatible coordinatewise intersection rather than an infinite sum
sequence.reader_end: reader understands the one-fluid VPI ontology and has rediscovered why the pressure-complete mixed tower must be read through compatible finite Sobolev intersections

risks: Letting Section 1 tower exposition steal Section 2's historical discovery job.
Turning Dead into ordinary stagnation or treating Dead, Jump, and Blown as disjoint exhaustive cases.
Letting a local graph picture erase the nonlocal pressure coupling.
Recasting the settled whole-terminal producer as an open or missing estimate.

prediction.choice_reason: Thomas supplied the governing movement and explicitly authorized restructuring; the strongest authorship move is to realize that score fully while exercising judgment only over subsection boundaries, mathematical formulation, and exposition depth.
uncertainties: Subsection boundaries may change during drafting when two supplied beats prove to be one continuous mathematical movement.
The VPI graph metaphor will be retained only as a secondary visualization because pressure coupling is nonlocal.

authorial_commitment.work_target: Live human-submission Navier--Stokes manuscript, Sections 1 and 2.
authorial_commitment.strongest_move_reason: The supplied subject order already carries the paper's causal logic; full development makes that logic legible without inventing a competing architecture.
authorial_commitment.intellectual_gain: Gold and Silver become one class-boundary argument, whose physical content forces the one-fluid tower and whose analytic content forces the compatible Sobolev intersection.
authorial_commitment.reader_gain: Every new object arrives because the preceding one has exposed a precise inadequacy, so the reader can reconstruct the proof architecture instead of memorizing terminology.

structural_commitment.inherited_reader_state: The existing draft states many ingredients but does not yet make their causal sequence or distinct jobs legible.
structural_commitment.section_job: Section 1 establishes the problem, routes, class boundary, failure pictures, and one-fluid ontology; Section 2 reconstructs the tower-to-intersection discovery.
structural_commitment.outgoing_reader_need: The reader must arrive at Section 3 knowing exactly what whole-terminal compatible object the formal closure realizes and why it is the right object.
structural_commitment.gap_payment: Join only continuous movements, split distinct reader changes, and add the missing physical and mathematical consequences inside each supplied beat.
structural_commitment.enrichment_reason: Thomas explicitly required further development rather than compression, and the mathematical transitions need concrete examples and derivations to become intuitive.

enrichments.detail: A distributional Euler slip-sheet calculation and its fixed-viscosity failure.
enrichments.reader_value: Makes class exit visible before the abstract tower.
enrichments.restraint: Present it as one comparison witness, not a classification of every singularity.

enrichments.detail: Material acceleration, Eulerian temporal rows, mixed jets, and first explicit recurrences.
enrichments.reader_value: Shows why velocity alone is not the smoothness object.
enrichments.placement: Section 1 introduces the ontology; Section 2 performs the analytic discovery.
enrichments.restraint: Do not identify material jerk with the second Eulerian time derivative.

enrichments.detail: Critical-height rows, Sobolev embedding, finite rectangles, and restriction compatibility.
enrichments.reader_value: Makes the intersection arise from the equation rather than appear as imposed notation.
enrichments.restraint: Do not replace the coordinatewise intersection by an infinite summed norm.
